figures.Fig10.8: Figure 10.8 (a) An Ag+/Ag, Zn2+/Zn electrochemical cell, (b) The difference between +0.80 V and -0.76 V is +1.56 V (PDF page 230). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch10-fig-ag-zn-cell (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure draws the arrows on the connecting wire pointing from the silver (+) electrode to the zinc (-) electrode while labelling the wire e-; electrons flow from the negative to the positive terminal, so the arrows are drawn from zinc (-) to silver (+) (correct). In panel (b) the two lines are placed at +0.80 V and -0.76 V on the scale.

findings: Figure 10.8 (a) draws the wire arrows from silver (+) to zinc (-) while labelling them e-; the redrawn figure shows electron flow from zinc to silver and the Roman Urdu lesson notes the correction.
